name: Election results day (4 Jun 2024)
description: One-day replay of the 2024 Lok Sabha results day.
rationale: Votes were counted on 4 Jun 2024 and the result differed from the exit polls; Nifty 50 fell from 23,263.90 to 21,884.50 (-5.93%) in one session in our cache.
caveats: The base close (3 Jun) was itself +3.25% on the exit polls, so the one-day fall partly reverses that rally.
The market rebounded the next session (+3.36% on 5 Jun); a one-day window shows a shock, not a lasting loss.
